how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-alterac-valley-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7081:obj:0: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7081:details:0: The graveyards in ⟦E2⟧ are prized territories. Both the ⟦E3⟧ and the ⟦E4⟧ fight savagely for these sacred grounds. Are you, ⟦1⟧, ready to join that fight?
rows.quest:7081:details:1: BI want you to assault an enemy graveyard. Find a graveyard with a ⟦E3⟧ banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! Do that, and your task will be complete....
rows.quest:7081:details:2: BBut if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.
rows.quest:7081:completion:0: Well done! Graveyards are vital to our control of ⟦E2⟧. When you capture one, you help ensure the ⟦E4⟧'s sovereignty here.
rows.quest:7081:completion:1: BGo now, ⟦2⟧. Reenter the battle, and if you see a graveyard under the ⟦E3⟧'s control... you know what to do!
rows.quest:7082:obj:0: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7082:details:0: The battle lines of ⟦E2⟧ are ever shifting. Territories swing back and forth as we meet our opponents in deadly combat. And graveyards, ⟦3⟧, are where battles rage most fierce.
rows.quest:7082:details:1: BI want you to attack an ⟦E4⟧ held graveyard! Find a graveyard with an ⟦E4⟧ banner in its midst and pull it from the ground.
rows.quest:7082:details:2: BDo that and your task for me will be complete, but... if you hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then it will be ours and troops will come and relieve you.
rows.quest:7082:completion:0: Well done, ⟦4⟧! With each graveyard under our control, the spirits of our enemies will wander more lost and aimless.
rows.quest:7101:obj:0: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7101:details:0: Towers and bunkers are important positions, and we must capture and hold them all! So to that end, I want you to attack a bunker that is controlled by the enemy.
rows.quest:7101:details:1: BTo do that, enter one with an ⟦E4⟧ banner. You will see another banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white ⟦E3⟧ banner will appear in its place. Well done!
rows.quest:7101:details:2: BAt that point your task for me will be complete, but if you hold the place long enough, and if the ⟦E4⟧ doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
rows.quest:7101:completion:0: I heard of your mission's success! That pleases me...
rows.quest:7101:completion:1: BOur troops can now charge forward with impunity, and show the ⟦E4⟧ that ⟦E2⟧ is no place for them!
rows.quest:7102:obj:0: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7102:details:0: Towers and bunkers are key defensive positions, and so we must hold as many as possible! I want you to attack a tower or a bunker in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7102:details:1: BTo do that, enter a tower with a ⟦E3⟧ banner atop it. You will see another enemy banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white ⟦E4⟧ banner will appear in its place. Well done!
rows.quest:7102:details:2: BAt that point your mission for me will be complete, but hold the area long enough, and if the ⟦E3⟧ doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
rows.quest:7102:completion:0: I received a field report stating you helped secure an enemy banner. Well done, ⟦5⟧! With their ranged troops out of position we can move the line of battle forward!
rows.quest:7121:details:0: ⟦6⟧, our quartermaster charged me to direct new recruits to him. He needs supplies from caches stored in the mines of Alterac, and he'll probably send you to get them.
rows.quest:7121:details:1: BFollow the road. You'll find our quartermaster to the west.
rows.quest:7121:completion:0: It's good to see fresh troops here, ⟦7⟧, but with a little luck you'll get into some action and won't be fresh for long!
rows.quest:7121:completion:1: BSpeak with me again. I have tasks I must discuss with you....
rows.quest:7122:obj:0: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7122:details:0: The mines in ⟦E2⟧ hold more than just minerals. Both the ⟦E5⟧ and Stormpike have cached excess supplies in the Irondeep and Coldtooth mines... that's not a bad idea, if we could only maintain control of them!
rows.quest:7122:details:1: BCapture a mine, then return to me. To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When you do that, the mine will be ours, and we'll send troops to protect it!
rows.quest:7122:completion:1: BWhen we control a mine and have troops stationed there, it's much easier to gather minerals and supplies from it.
rows.quest:7123:details:0: ⟦9⟧, the ⟦E5⟧ Quartermaster is looking for recruits, for tasks that lead into the mines of ⟦E2⟧. Speak with him; he will tell you more.
rows.quest:7123:details:1: BFollow the road west into the bunker, then take the west exit and you'll find our quartermaster.
rows.quest:7123:completion:0: Hail, ⟦10⟧! It is good to see a ⟦11⟧ like yourself, eager to do his part for the ⟦E3⟧. Speak with me again, for I have vital tasks for you...
rows.quest:7124:obj:0: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7124:details:0: As battle rages over the landscape of ⟦E2⟧, so too does it rage through the Coldtooth and Irondeep mines. Both are rich sources of minerals and both are used to store supplies; it's no wonder they are so highly valued!
rows.quest:7124:details:1: BHelp our war effort, ⟦12⟧! Capture one of the mines for the ⟦E3⟧! To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When that is done, the mine will be ours and we'll send troops to protect it!
rows.quest:7124:completion:0: You captured a mine! With our own warriors protecting it, it will be much simpler to extract minerals from its depths, or gather supplies that have been cached there.
rows.quest:7124:completion:1: BWell done, ⟦13⟧>. The deed you have done is a great boon to our battle efforts.
rows.quest:7141:obj:0: Enter ⟦E2⟧, defeat the ⟦E3⟧ general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7141:details:0: The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in ⟦E2⟧, but the ⟦E5⟧ orcs won't let us explore. We can't allow the ⟦E3⟧ to stop our scholarly pursuits! Defeat the ⟦E5⟧ general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge.
rows.quest:7141:details:1: BDrek'Thar is in ⟦E5⟧ Keep, in the south of ⟦E2⟧. Vanquish him, and then return to me.
rows.quest:7141:completion:0: Well done, ⟦14⟧! With the ⟦E3⟧'s nose bloodied after the death of their general, we'll have the breathing room we need to explore!
rows.quest:7142:obj:0: Enter ⟦E2⟧ and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7142:details:0: The Stormpike dwarves and their allies have invaded ⟦E2⟧, and we must drive them out! To win the battle for Alterac, we must defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike!
rows.quest:7142:details:1: BYou will find Vanndar in Dun Baldar, in the north of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7142:details:2: BDestroy him, ⟦15⟧, and then return to me.
rows.quest:7142:completion:0: Well done, ⟦16⟧! Stormpikes have no hope in this foolish invasion.
rows.quest:7142:completion:1: BHah! So far, all they've done is get their general killed!
rows.quest:7161:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in ⟦E2⟧ and find the ⟦E5⟧ Banner. Return the ⟦E5⟧ Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.
rows.quest:7161:details:0: Hail, ⟦17⟧. It has been a long time since we have had the chance to answer the call of battle. The old feelings are slow to rise but once awakened, the blood does rush. The battle rage returns...
rows.quest:7161:details:1: BAll newcomers to the Valley must first complete the rite of battle.
rows.quest:7161:details:2: BDeep within the Wildpaw gnoll cave is a banner of the ⟦E5⟧. Venture forth and recover the banner. Return it to me and I shall grant you the ⟦E5⟧ initiate's insignia.
rows.quest:7161:completion:0: That burning sensation you feel is your soul being awakened. Your spirit has accepted the call to arms.
rows.quest:7161:completion:1: BYou are now one of the ⟦E5⟧, ⟦18⟧. Congratulations.
rows.quest:7161:completion:2: BCarry this insignia with you at all times. As you advance among the ranks of ⟦E5⟧, I will replace the insignia with other, more powerful insignias.
rows.quest:7161:completion:3: BPerhaps someday you will be exalted among the ⟦E5⟧ Clan. Should that day ever come, you will be granted the Eye of Command.
rows.quest:7162:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in ⟦E2⟧ and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7162:details:0: You've arrived just in time, ⟦19⟧. These ⟦E5⟧ savages just won't give up! We must show them the might of the Stormpike. They must bow to our superiority.
rows.quest:7162:details:1: BBefore you make your way to the field of battle, you will want to join the rank of Stormpike.
rows.quest:7162:details:2: BSouthwest of Dun Baldar, you will find the Icewing Caverns. Planted deep within the caverns is a Stormpike Banner. Venture forth and recover that banner. Return it to me, and you will have earned a Stormpike initiate's insignia.
rows.quest:7162:completion:0: Take and wear this insignia with pride, ⟦20⟧. As your rank among the Stormpike grows, so too will the insignia. Return to me as you gain honor with Stormpike, and I shall replace your insignia with other, more powerful insignias.
rows.quest:7162:completion:1: BPerhaps someday you will grow to be a legend on this field of battle. Should that day ever come, you will be granted the Eye of Command.
rows.quest:7163:details:1: BIt is your time, ⟦22⟧. You have done much for the ⟦E5⟧ Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of ⟦E5⟧ but also as a friend.
rows.quest:7163:details:2: BWell done! Present your initiate's insignia.⟦23⟧
rows.quest:7163:completion:0: This new insignia reflects your rank amongst the ⟦E5⟧. Keep it on you at all times.⟦24⟧⟦25⟧And ⟦26⟧... Die with honor!
rows.quest:7164:details:0: It is good to see you again, ⟦27⟧. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7164:details:1: BYour time has come again, ⟦28⟧. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.
rows.quest:7164:completion:1: BGo, ⟦30⟧! Continue your defense of the ⟦E5⟧. This war must be won! For Drek'Thar! For the Warchief!
rows.quest:7165:details:0: I must know, ⟦31⟧. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
rows.quest:7165:details:1: BYou have earned reverence among the Guard.
rows.quest:7165:completion:0: ⟦32⟧⟦33⟧⟦34⟧They have already begun telling tales of your deeds, soldier. The Stormpike shakes in fear when your name is uttered. Carry on!
rows.quest:7166:details:0: Your radiate command and power, shaman. Exalted in the eyes of ⟦E5⟧ - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.
rows.quest:7166:details:1: BRise, Hero of ⟦E5⟧. Rise and be honored!
rows.quest:7166:completion:0: Soon, all on the field of battle will be under your watchful eye. Command of the Valley and its troops will be yours!
rows.quest:7167:details:0: Drek'Thar sings your praises. ⟦E7⟧ is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.
rows.quest:7167:details:1: BYou have earned the Eye of Command.
rows.quest:7167:completion:0: Channel the power of the insignia. Let the enemy hear your words. The might of the ⟦E3⟧ is unquestionable!
rows.quest:7168:details:0: Most do not live long enough to rise above their own mediocrity. You have proven yourself to be an exemplary soldier, ⟦37⟧. The time has come.
rows.quest:7168:completion:0: Let our enemies see that a soldier of rank has struck them down! Fight for the glory of Stormpike!
rows.quest:7169:details:0: The base buzzes with news of your exploits in the Field of Strife! You have struck mighty blows against our enemy - crushing their morale! For this, you have earned a rank of honor among the Stormpike.
rows.quest:7169:completion:0: The king has been made aware of your battlefront heroics, ⟦38⟧. Continue in your stalwart defense of the Stormpike Guard!
rows.quest:7170:details:0: I must know, ⟦39⟧. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
rows.quest:7170:details:1: BYou have earned reverence among the Guard.
rows.quest:7170:completion:0: When we first met, I would have never guessed that a hero was in the making. Carry on, soldier!
rows.quest:7171:details:0: Your radiate command and power, shaman. Exalted in the eyes of ⟦E5⟧ - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.
rows.quest:7171:details:1: BRise, Hero of ⟦E5⟧. Rise and be honored!
rows.quest:7171:completion:0: Surely it will be you who carries the Eye of Command!
rows.quest:7172:details:0: It is good to see you again, ⟦40⟧. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7172:details:1: BYour time has come again, ⟦41⟧. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.
rows.quest:7172:completion:0: It is you who must lead our troops to victory, Commander! The soldiers are under your command. They will follow your direct orders. Lead them.... Crush the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7181:obj:0: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7181:obj:1: BShould Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Warmaster Laggrond.
rows.quest:7181:details:0: The invading Stormpike are not the only threat in the region, soldier. The war in the Valley is waged on two fronts. The cannibal Winterax trolls also vie for power.
rows.quest:7181:details:1: BThey are lead by Korrak the Bloodrager - a cruel and cunning beast.
rows.quest:7181:details:2: BA strike against Korrak could prove to be a crushing blow to the Winterax clan. Slay the beast and be rewarded!
rows.quest:7202:obj:0: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7202:obj:1: BShould Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7202:details:0: The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew.
rows.quest:7202:details:1: BWe must show them our might!
rows.quest:7202:details:2: BWe have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known.
rows.quest:7202:details:3: BDeath to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! Slay him and return.
rows.quest:7221:obj:0: Speak with Prospector Stonehewer in the Dun Baldar garrison.
rows.quest:7221:details:0: Ah, ⟦42⟧, reporting for duty are you? Great, the Stormpikes can use everyone we can muster!
rows.quest:7221:details:1: BSpeak with Prospector Stonehewer in Dun Baldar. She's recruiting for a vital mission into enemy territory. You'll find Stonehewer in the bottom of the Dun Baldar garrison.
rows.quest:7221:details:2: BAnd keep an eye out as you go through Dun Baldar. There's plenty to do for a hardworking ⟦43⟧ who's not afraid to get ⟦44⟧ hands dirty.
rows.quest:7222:details:0: A ⟦45⟧? Good! We are glad to see you in Alterac, ⟦46⟧. Interloping dwarves and their allies invade our valley, and we welcome all in the ⟦E3⟧ to join us in righteous slaughter!
rows.quest:7222:details:1: BSpeak with Voggah Deathgrip. He is looking for agents for an important mission into the ⟦E4⟧'s stronghold in ⟦E2⟧!
rows.quest:7222:details:2: BYou will find Voggah in ⟦E5⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:7223:obj:0: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.
rows.quest:7223:details:0: Battles rage constantly in ⟦E2⟧, and the supplies we get from ⟦E8⟧ are not enough to outfit our experienced troops.
rows.quest:7223:details:1: BIf you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!
rows.quest:7223:completion:0: These are some good pieces, ⟦47⟧. I can use them to fashion new equipment for our troops.
rows.quest:7223:completion:1: BIf my supply level gets high enough, then maybe our seasoned fighting units will enter the field!
rows.quest:7224:obj:0: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in ⟦E5⟧ Village.
rows.quest:7224:details:0: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me. I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!
rows.quest:7224:completion:0: These will do nicely. I'll melt them down and patch them up and you'll never know they came from those Stormpike cowards!
rows.quest:7224:completion:1: BThanks, ⟦48⟧. And let me polish up that armor of yours...
rows.quest:7241:obj:0: Venture to ⟦E2⟧, located in the ⟦E1⟧. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of ⟦E5⟧. You will find ⟦E2⟧ north of Tarren Mill at the base of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7241:details:0: The drums of war sound off in a distant land, ⟦49⟧. The favored clan of your Warchief is under attack from the nefarious Stormpike Guard of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:7241:details:1: BBy the looks of you, I can discern that you are indeed battle hardy and prepared to take on the cause of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7241:details:2: BIt is you who must now take the next step in your evolution.
rows.quest:7241:details:3: BNorth of Tarren Mill, in Alterac, you will find the entrance to ⟦E2⟧. It is there that you will find Warmaster Laggrond. Hurry ⟦50⟧, for the battle is upon us!
rows.quest:7241:completion:0: To become a soldier of ⟦E5⟧, one must first be tested...
rows.quest:7261:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E2⟧ in the ⟦E9⟧. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
rows.quest:7261:details:0: We are fighting a brutal battle in the valleys of Alterac. The cannibalistic Winterax trolls attack us from one side and the savage ⟦E5⟧ Clan from the other. Both must be exterminated in the name of King Magni Bronzebeard! The taking, culling, and turning of that land is a sovereign and territorial imperative to the kingdom of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:7261:details:1: BAlas, soldiers do not grow on trees! Report to Lieutenant Haggerdin outside ⟦E2⟧ to begin your tour of duty and honor amongst the Stormpike.
rows.quest:7281:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.⟦51⟧
rows.quest:7281:details:0: Tragic... My brother faces me on the field of battle: A commander for the Stormpike.
rows.quest:7281:details:1: BOf the four Stormpike Commanders, he is undoubtedly the most dangerous. Perhaps if he is slain, the Banshee Queen could turn him as she did me - show him the error of his ways...
rows.quest:7281:details:2: BDeep within enemy territory you will find my brother. Slay him and return to me. I trust that you are capable of completing this mission, soldier.
rows.quest:7281:details:3: BAnd soldier, do not go alone.
rows.quest:7281:completion:0: Your heroics will not go unnoticed, ⟦52⟧.
rows.quest:7281:completion:1: BI must waste no time if he is to be saved. Sylvanas must be contacted!
rows.quest:7282:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ into ⟦E5⟧ territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.⟦53⟧
rows.quest:7282:details:0: He must be put out of his misery, soldier! He knows not what he does. He has become a mindless servant of the dreaded Banshee Queen.
rows.quest:7282:details:1: BVenture forth, across the Field of Strife, to the depths of ⟦E5⟧ territory. Find my brother and destroy him. His torment must come to an end.
rows.quest:7282:completion:0: You did remember to burn the corpse, didn't you?
rows.quest:7301:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ to ⟦E5⟧ territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander ⟦E10⟧, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.
rows.quest:7301:details:0: We got them held prisoner, ⟦54⟧. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against ⟦E5⟧ Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them.
rows.quest:7301:details:1: BSearch Tower Point West and ⟦E5⟧ Keep. These were their last known locations. Search these areas thoroughly.
rows.quest:7301:completion:0: Unbelievable! You did free them, right? Right??? Well at the very least we know where they were held.
rows.quest:7302:obj:0: Find out what became of Wing Commander ⟦E11⟧, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.
rows.quest:7302:details:0: Our air support is in shambles, ⟦55⟧. The Wing Commanders were shot down over enemy territory. You must find out what became of them so that we can attempt a rescue!
rows.quest:7302:details:1: BGuse was last seen flying over the Icewing Bunker. Jeztor's War Rider was spotted near the Stormpike lumber mill. Mulverick... that reckless fool was seen crashing near the Dun'Baldar North Bunker.
rows.quest:7302:details:2: BThat's all the information I have. Move out! Search through the areas thoroughly.
rows.quest:7302:completion:0: Well done! The information you recovered will be invaluable to our cause.
rows.quest:7361:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing night elf players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7361:obj:1: BKill a night elf and return to Najak Hexxen at ⟦E5⟧ Keep with a Severed Night Elf Head.
rows.quest:7361:details:1: BBefore the night elves existed there was troll. It was from troll that the night elves came.
rows.quest:7361:details:2: BTheir mutinous attacks against my people will not be tolerated. Staghelm seeks to wipe us out - to leave no trace of those that bore him and his ilk. It will not happen!
rows.quest:7361:details:3: BFor every night elf that you slay and decapitate, Najak will grant you favor amongst the ⟦E12⟧. Word of your deeds will be spread across ⟦E7⟧ and the ⟦E13⟧. Go now and serve the ⟦E12⟧!
rows.quest:7361:completion:0: ⟦57⟧, it is but one of thousands. A job well done nonetheless.
rows.quest:7362:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7362:obj:1: BKill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at ⟦E5⟧ Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.
rows.quest:7362:details:0: The Elder Crone has sent me to this warzone to research the other races. More specifically, I am to collect gnome samples. Magatha is primarily interested in their survivability. Aye, the gnomes - while pitifully weak and miniscule - exude great resilience both in and out of combat.
rows.quest:7362:details:1: BFortunately for you, I am looking for ruffians to do Magatha's bidding. Return to me with tufts of gnome hair and you shall be known to the tauren as an ally.
rows.quest:7362:completion:0: Aye, this is definitely gnome. Well done, ⟦58⟧, but there is more work to be done.
rows.quest:7363:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing human players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7363:obj:1: BKill a human and return to Commander Louis Philips (who wanders between the front lines and ⟦E5⟧ keep) with a Human Bone Chip.
rows.quest:7363:obj:2: BA cure for the human condition is close at hand!
rows.quest:7363:details:2: BWhile it is true that I am a soldier of ⟦E5⟧, I remain a servant of Sylvanas.
rows.quest:7363:details:3: BDuring my tour of duty, I do extra work on the side for the Dark Apothecaries of the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:7363:details:4: BI have been tasked with collecting human bone chips that are to be used in curing the human condition.
rows.quest:7363:details:5: BI am authorized to pass that task on to my subordinates.
rows.quest:7363:details:6: BFind them. Kill them. Return their bone chips to me.
rows.quest:7363:completion:0: It would be easier if they just accepted their illness and gave in to your healing touch. It would also probably be less fun. Carry on! We'll cure them, one way or another.
rows.quest:7364:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing tauren players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7364:obj:1: BKill a tauren and return to Dirk Swindle at Dun'Baldar with a Tauren Hoof.
rows.quest:7364:details:0: The High Tinkerer himself has sent me to this field of battle to defend my gnomish brothers and sisters. We have received word that the tauren are singling out and slaying gnomes. Worst of all, they are removing tufts of glorious gnome hair from the corpses of the fallen. These atrocities must be stopped. We must reciprocate!
rows.quest:7364:details:1: BI want them de-hoofed, ⟦60⟧. Bring me their hooves! Show yourself as an ally of the gnomes.
rows.quest:7365:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing troll players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7365:obj:1: BKill a troll and return to Athramanis at Dun'Baldar with ⟦E12⟧ Troll Mojo.
rows.quest:7365:details:0: Staghelm has given the order. All trolls on the field of battle must be exterminated. Their preposterous claims of birthing night elves must be met with force and due prejudice.
rows.quest:7365:details:1: BSlay them and return to me with their mojo. To reiterate: I want you to steal their mojo.
rows.quest:7366:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing ⟦E15⟧ players in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:7366:obj:1: BKill a ⟦E15⟧ and return to Commander Karl Philips (who wanders between the lumber mill and the mine) with a ⟦E15⟧ Heart.
rows.quest:7366:details:0: The Archbishop is as kind as he is wise. For a man to look mercifully on such a wretched lot...
rows.quest:7366:details:1: B<Commander Philips shakes his head in disbelief.>
rows.quest:7366:details:3: BThe Archbishop asks that we take pity on the undead and grant them swift and permanent deaths. For this grand display of mercy, we merely require their black, disease ridden hearts.
rows.quest:7366:details:4: BBring me the hearts of the ⟦E15⟧ so that they may be ceremoniously incinerated at the Cathedral of Light. Make haste, ⟦61⟧!
rows.quest:7366:completion:0: Praise be to Benedictus! Another lost soul, soon to be saved by the white hot flames of the Light!
rows.quest:7366:completion:1: BGo ye, oh soldier of Light! More must be saved!
